children.label: STM and LTM Definitions
children.current_state: The need to establish agent-specific definitions for 'short-term memory' (STM) and 'long-term memory' (LTM) has been raised, as they are distinct from human memory concepts. A proposal suggests defining STM as important project-related matters from recent weeks or months, rather than just immediate recall. This definitional framework is seen as a prerequisite for developing effective memory retrieval strategies.
